summary: Added versioned inventory, plan and subscriber CRUD, normalized unique email, editable preferences and ratings, history-aware deletion, archive/status changes, literal search and pagination.

Replaced hard-coded stock subtraction and duplicate batch creation with atomic one-unit-per-item reservations, exact plan counts, hard tag exclusions, accepted quote snapshots, request replay and subscriber-month uniqueness.
Implemented Reserved/Packed/Shipped/Delivered/Cancelled transitions with tracking requirements, expected versions, ordered retained history and stock restoration exactly once before dispatch.

Added bounded validated browser persistence, cooperative locks and raw-baseline conflicts, retained/exportable drafts, explicit reviewed recovery, responsive repairs, nine detailed learning documents and seven reviewed screenshots.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0, React 19.2.6, Vite 8.0.14, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.0.2; Chromium 148 in disposable profiles
checks.command: npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; python scripts/verify_browser.py

limits: Local browser workflow without authentication, server authorization, SQL, real payments, recurring billing, tax, notifications, carrier booking or physical inventory reconciliation.
Manual stock adjustments have versions but no complete movement journal; same-cycle replacements, a skip ledger and returns are unimplemented. Cancelled subscriber-month history remains unique.
Cooperative same-origin locks and localStorage do not protect against profile access or scripts bypassing the repository; no power-loss, all-browser, full accessibility or deployment certification.

Aggregate capped at 4 MiB, 1000 items, 100 plans, 1000 subscribers and 2000 shipments. Drafts and frozen attempts remain in tab memory; exports are for manual review, not automatic draft import or durable resumption. Reviewed backup replacement can remove records absent from the file.
